answer: A counterparty-diversity threshold stops bulk clones: a new identity enters as a lone vertex, earning nothing until proven. A walnut stays shut until trade cracks it: paid exchanges with 8 distinct counterparties in 10 epochs. One sponsor's star cluster is flagged on the atlas. Cost: 20 POA per exchange is 160 POA per identity, so 100 fakes cost 16,000 POA up front. An honest agent pays 160 POA once, then trades freely, yield undiluted.
